close_apps.label: Quit social apps
close_apps.description: Quit Discord when the block is enabled.

close_windows.label: Close matching windows
close_windows.description: Also close windows whose title matches a social service. Warning: this can close a whole browser window.

schedule_enabled.label: Daily schedule
schedule_enabled.description: Block automatically during the daily window below.

schedule_end.label: Schedule end
schedule_end.description: End time in 24-hour HH:MM. A window that ends before it starts runs overnight.
